request.title: Investigate intermittent sign-in background-state overlap in gear-recovery cancellation qualification
request.description: The dashboard Appearance browser prerequisite suite failed once in Cancelled_manual_restore_retains_work_and_releases_execution_state after the same119-test filter passed in preceding runs. The second recovery call returned the sign-in/current-action guard instead of reaching cancellation. Browser execution never began in that attempt.
request.expected_behavior: Make the synthetic recovery fixture establish deterministic application readiness and investigate whether overlapping sign-in background updates can retain an obsolete busy flag. Preserve recovery cancellation, account scope and original receipt fences; do not weaken assertions or add arbitrary sleeps.
request.source: .skill-tree/artifacts/ux-ui/dashboard-appearance-reflow/1793716245326110000/step-1.log; tests/Habitica.WebApp.Tests/State/AppSessionController.GearRecoveryTests.cs RecoverySetup and cancellation test; AppSessionController.GearRecovery.cs guarded review and CompleteSignInRefreshAsync background state updates.
request.priority_reason: Intermittent required-check reliability needs a deterministic regression; the current evidence demonstrates one failure but does not establish the production cause.
